'''2017 Worlds Day 2 Cory Lauer DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cory Lauer]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Cory Lauer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
